notes.title: Update announcement at 14:30 on November 6

In order to bring you a better experience of the game, we will update "matchless in the world" at 14:30 on November 6 (Wednesday), during which players will not be able to enter the game for 10-20 minutes! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to you!

Update time: 14:30, Wednesday, November 6 (10-20 minutes can't experience the game)

Maintenance scope: unparalleled in the world
